summary.en: Classic chess against a friend or the bot
summary.fa: شطرنج کلاسیک با دوستت یا با ربات

description.en: Chess with the full rules: castling, en passant, promotion, checkmate and stalemate, and draws by threefold repetition, the fifty-move rule or too little material. Play a friend, or play alone against the bot at easy, medium or hard. Offer a draw or resign, follow the moves, and watch the replay afterwards.
description.fa: شطرنج با همهٔ قوانین: قلعه، آن‌پاسان، ارتقای سرباز، کیش و مات و پات، و مساوی با تکرار سه‌باره، قانون ۵۰ حرکت یا کمبود مهره. با دوستت بازی کن، یا تنها با ربات در سطح ساده، متوسط یا سخت. مساوی پیشنهاد بده یا تسلیم شو، حرکت‌ها را دنبال کن و بعد بازی را دوباره ببین.

summary.en: Race a rover, a dirt bike, a buggy or a monster truck over the hills, live
summary.fa: با جیپ، تریل، باگی یا مانستر تراک روی تپه‌ها زنده مسابقه بده

description.en: Two to four drivers race over the same course in real time, each in the vehicle they pick: a sturdy rover, a 250 cc two-stroke dirt bike, a light dune buggy or a monster truck. Gas and brake are all you have: on the ground they drive, in the air they flip you back and forward. Land back flips and front flips for points and a boost; land on your head and you go back to the last checkpoint. Your vehicle answers at once, however far the server is. First over the line wins, and your best time and stunt score on every course and vehicle are kept as your records.
description.fa: دو تا چهار نفر همزمان روی یک مسیر مسابقه می‌دهند، هر کدام با وسیله‌ای که انتخاب می‌کند: جیپ محکم، موتور تریل ۲۵۰ سی‌سی دوزمانه، باگی سبک یا مانستر تراک. فقط گاز و ترمز داری: روی زمین می‌رانند و در هوا تو را به عقب و جلو می‌چرخانند. بک‌فلیپ و فرانت‌فلیپ بزن تا امتیاز و توربو بگیری؛ اگر با سر زمین بخوری به آخرین ایست بازرسی برمی‌گردی. وسیله‌ات همان لحظه جواب می‌دهد، هر قدر هم سرور دور باشد. اولین کسی که از خط پایان رد شود برنده است و بهترین زمان و امتیاز حرکاتت در هر مسیر و با هر وسیله به‌عنوان رکوردت ثبت می‌شود.

changelog.en:
- Smooth motion when the server runs a little behind real time (a busy
  host): the race clock follows the server's own pace, and your vehicle
  never stops to wait for it but runs a touch faster or slower until it
  is where it should be (1.1.1 could move in steps).
- The others run on for at most 120 ms past a late frame (was 250 ms), so
  they jump less when it comes.
- Paints: pick your vehicle's colour in the garage from ten, or keep your
  seat's. The others see it, and it is remembered for the next race.

- Smooth on a weak connection: frames that come late or in a burst no
  longer stop your vehicle (the race clock is the least late estimate),
  a burst is checked once, and only after more than a second without any
  frame does your race slow down, gently, to wait for the server.
- Inputs go as runs of held buttons, so one message carries seconds of
  them: after a stall the first one through gives the server every tick
  it missed, and your vehicle is not pulled back.
- The server waits up to 1.5 s (was 0.5 s) for a slow driver before it
  drives on with the last input.
- The others are drawn further in the past when frames come unevenly,
  and run on for a moment instead of stopping when a frame is late.

- New physics: the chassis and both wheels are rigid bodies on sliding
  suspensions with stops, the engine and brakes act between wheel and
  chassis (wheelies, nose-dives under braking), tyres grip with friction,
  and traction and wheelie control keep full throttle drivable.
- Your vehicle answers at once: the frontend runs it with the same
  simulation as the server, bit for bit, and corrects itself from the
  server; finish times count each seat's own ticks.
- Four vehicles to pick in the garage before the start: rover, Dirt 250
  (a 250 cc two-stroke motocross bike), dune buggy and monster truck.
- Back flips and front flips score points and a boost; big air scores too.
- Courses with kicks to jump from, no hill steeper than a vehicle can
  climb, and checkpoints with a run-up.
- Records per course, distance and vehicle: best time and stunt score.
